description: This file defines classes and structs related to NVIDIA's Neural Network Compiler (NNC) within the PyTorch JIT mobile namespace, including specifications for input/output tensors, execution state, memory planning, symbolic shape positioning, and classes for functions and compilation units used in NNC code execution.

classes.name: InputSpec
classes.description: Specifies requirements for an input tensor, including size and data type, with methods for serialization, deserialization, and validation.

classes.name: OutputSpec
classes.description: Defines output tensor specifications such as size, data type, and quantization parameters, with methods for serialization and allocation.

classes.name: ExecutionState
classes.description: Holds temporary buffers and argument pointers needed during execution of NNC functions.

classes.name: MemoryPlan
classes.description: Details how to allocate temporary buffers for NNC execution, supporting serialization and allocation.

classes.name: SymbolicShapePosition
classes.description: Represents the position of a symbolic shape within input tensor dimensions.

classes.name: Function
classes.description: Represents a compiled NNC function with methods for serialization, execution, and managing associated metadata.

classes.name: CompilationUnit
classes.description: Contains a set of compiled NNC functions, supporting registration, serialization, and execution.

methods.name: serialize()
methods.description: Serializes the object into an IValue.

methods.name: validate(const at::Tensor&)
methods.description: Checks if a tensor adheres to the specification.

methods.name: allocate()
methods.description: Allocates an output tensor based on the spec.

methods.name: allocate(ExecutionState*)
methods.description: Allocates buffers in the given execution state.

methods.name: SymbolicShapePosition(int64_t, int64_t)
methods.description: Constructs a position with input and dimension indices.

methods.name: serialize()
methods.description: Serializes the Function into an IValue.

methods.name: run(const c10::impl::GenericList&)
methods.description: Executes the compiled NNC function with given inputs.

methods.name: nnc_kernel_id()
methods.description: Returns the kernel ID associated with the function.

methods.name: parameters()
methods.description: Returns the list of parameters for the function.

methods.name: run(const c10::QualifiedName&, const c10::impl::GenericList&)
methods.description: Executes a registered function by name.

methods.name: find_function(const c10::QualifiedName&)
methods.description: Finds a function by name (private method).
